## Pull Request Summary

### Description
Provide a brief summary of the changes introduced by this pull request.

### Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix (non-breaking change which fixes an issue)
- [ ] New feature (non-breaking change which adds functionality)
- [ ] Accessibility enhancement (WCAG AAA, voice, contrast, screen reader)
- [ ] Security / configuration improvement
- [ ] Documentation update

### Testing
- [ ] Unit / Integration tests pass locally (`npm test --prefix server`)
- [ ] Frontend builds cleanly without error (`npm run build --prefix client`)
- [ ] Verified manually in browser / mobile viewport

### Checklist
- [ ] My code adheres to the project code standards
- [ ] No secrets, `.env` files, or API credentials are included
- [ ] Updated relevant documentation or README if necessary
